name: hashira-npm-release-dry-run-fixture
description: Static fixture for the npm-release dry-run self-CI job. version 0.0.0 + no conventional-commit history → semantic-release reports 'no release this run'. 'private: true' is REQUIRED here (not just defense-in-depth): the npm-release builder always sets npmPublish:true, and @semantic-release/npm verifies npm auth ONLY when npmPublish!==false AND pkg.private!==true (index.js). The dry-run self-CI job grants no id-token/NPM_TOKEN, so private:true is what lets verifyConditions pass without auth. Removing it breaks the job with an opaque auth error.
